title: PassSync

prizes.title: Best use of Account Abstraction and Base Paymaster

description:
In the current state of Smart Contract Wallets, one of the major way to generate wallets is using passkeys, however there's a big issue surrounding it regarding the fragmentation of passkeys when using it to signup at different domains, ie, same passkeys with same username it creates different credentials for different Dapps which is inconvinient for the user to maintain multiple wallets for Dapps, to sove this passync creates an unified custodial solution to create wallets using passkeys

**Links**
- [https://demo-arch0125.vercel.app/](https://demo-arch0125.vercel.app/)
how_its_made: One of the major challenges which we ran into was figuring out a possible solution to provide a custodial client for the user to generate passkey credentials consistently and would be able to generate the address
